summary: News Corp filed an 8-K disclosing daily repurchase activity under its existing $1 billion stock repurchase program, as required by Australian Securities Exchange rules. The filing attaches exhibits containing ASX disclosures but does not specify current repurchase amounts, prices, or dates. The program covers Class A and Class B common stock, repurchased from time to time subject to market conditions. This is a routine disclosure of ongoing buyback activity rather than a new capital return event. Watch for cumulative repurchase totals in forthcoming quarterly reports.
